subject: Derived-content governance & productization constraints — Order Form redlines
messages:
From: Danielle Reyes <danielle@atlashealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Order Form redlines — productization & training / initial proposal

Hi Karthik / Ben / Laura,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to attach a set of proposed redlines to the Order Form focused specifically on productization and training use of customer outputs. High level: AtlasHealth needs to ensure vendor cannot use our customer data or outputs to further train models that could be productized into third-party features. We are open to narrow operational telemetry for reliability/diagnostics, but want explicit non-use language for model training and a limited feedback license (read: for service improvement only, non-exclusive, non-commercial).

Key asks in the attached:
- No training on customer content or generated outputs without opt-in consent (per order form).
- Feedback license capped to anonymized, aggregated usage for service improvements, not to be used to build derivative features offered by Redwood.
- Clear evidence bucket: logs, telemetry types, retention windows.

We have a procurement deadline (vendor selection decision) on 2028-08-07. Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept these redlines as-is or propose compromise language? If you prefer a call, we can do 8/1 or 8/2.

Attachments: Atlas_Proposed_OrderForm_Redlines.docx (redline)

Thanks,
Danielle Reyes
Director, Vendor Sourcing
AtlasHealth

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Danielle Reyes <danielle@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 18:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form redlines — productization & training / initial proposal

Thanks Danielle — and thanks for the clear framing and the redline doc. Internal quick take and proposed path forward: 

1) We agree with AtlasHealth’s intent to protect customer outputs from being used to train models that are productized and sold back to customers.
2) Operational telemetry: we typically collect aggregated latency/error metrics and anonymized prompt/response hashes for debugging — we can commit to keeping those telemetry types out of any training dataset used for public model releases.
3) Compromise proposal (draft language included below): allow a limited, anonymized feedback license solely for service improvement (non-exclusive, royalty-free) and expressly prohibit use of customer-provided content and generated outputs for model training that creates commercial derivative features without explicit opt-in.

Draft redline snippet (high level):
"Vendor shall not use Customer Content or Customer Generated Outputs to train or refine models used to produce commercially distributed or productized model features for third parties or the general market, without Customer's prior written consent. Vendor may collect aggregated, anonymized telemetry for service reliability and debugging; such telemetry shall be excluded from model training datasets used for product releases."

Next steps I propose: Ben and Laura to take this into our legal redline queue and produce a response by EOD 7/31. Monica, can you pull the list of telemetry fields we log plus retention periods and put in the shared Drive folder? Danielle — we can provisionally pencil an 8/1 10:00 AM PT call to finalize language if that helps your procurement timeline.

I'll attach an internal working draft after Ben/Laura review.

Best,
Karthik
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Danielle Reyes <danielle@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 31 Jul 2028 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Order Form redlines — productization & training / legal redline suggestion

Karthik / Danielle — quick legal-oriented redline suggestion attached. My notes:

- Replace "train" with defined term "Model Training" and define as any process that adjusts model weights or parameters using Customer Content or Customer Generated Outputs.
- Add exclusion language that allows operational telemetry (explicitly enumerated: request latency, error rates, anonymized prompt/response fingerprints) for debugging and performance monitoring and confirm those items will not be used for Model Training that results in commercialized features.
- Add audit clause: on reasonable notice, we will provide an evidentiary summary showing how telemetry is handled (no raw customer content). We won't provide model weights or proprietary training datasets.

Suggested short redline (for Order Form, Exhibit A):
"Model Training. Vendor shall not perform Model Training using Customer Content or Customer Generated Outputs, except where Customer has provided explicit, written opt-in for a defined training engagement. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Vendor may collect and retain operational telemetry limited to: (i) request latency; (ii) error rates; (iii) anonymized usage fingerprints; provided that such telemetry is not included in Model Training datasets used to produce commercially distributed model features."

I attached OrderForm_Redline_for_legal.docx with tracked changes. Danielle — if this looks reasonable I can flag the redline to our contracts counsel for a final pass. Karthik — recommend we keep the call for 8/1 to close the few open items.

-Ben
Senior Manager, Contracts & GTM Ops
Redwood Inference

Attachment: OrderForm_Redline_for_legal.docx
